ui_usage_cost_note: Coggu ngu ko jamirɗinaa: ko ɗum token ɗee coggotoo e API joom golle ɗee e coggu laaɓtungu. Wonaa ko njoɓataa; abonmaa yoɓetaake e ɗaɓɓaande kala.
ui_idle_hint: Dobo e maandel ɓeyditte ngel ngam timminde ngoo hello.
ui_truncated: Ngoo hello ko juutngo; ko ɓolol arandewol tan timminaa.
error_page_unreadable: Ngoo hello waawaa jangeede. Kelle wanngorde e Chrome Web Store wallitaaka.
error_no_content: Alaa binndi winndannde njiyaa e ngoo hello.
error_needs_click: Dobo e maandel ɓeyditte ngel ngam timminde ngoo hello. Caggal nde tabbere nde yahi e hello goɗngo, ɓeyditte ngel ina haani dobeede kadi ngam jangde ngo.
error_host_missing: Pecel nokkuyankeewal ngal aafaaka walla ngal jaabotaako. E runngere ɓeyditte ngel, yaltin: ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_missing: Claude Code yiyaaka. Aaf ɗum, caggal ɗuum yaltin ./native-host/install.sh kadi.
error_claude_auth: A seŋaaki e Claude Code. Yaltin claude e termiinal, seŋo.
error_codex_signed_out: A seŋaaki e Codex. Yaltin codex login e termiinal.
error_codex_not_eligible: Fesaa maa ChatGPT waawaa huutoreede e ɗuum. Suɓo jeyɗo goɗɗo.
error_usage_limit: A yettiima keerol huutoraade fesaa maa. Eto kadi ɓaawo ɗuum walla suɓo jeyɗo goɗɗo.
error_provider_failed: Jeyɗo oo roŋkii tuma o winndata timmoode ndee. Eto kadi.
error_codex_missing: Codex yiyaaka. Aaf ɗum, caggal ɗuum yaltin ./native-host/install.sh kadi.
options_help: Timmooje ɗee ina njaha e pecel nokkuyankeewal ordinateer ngal: ina yaltina Claude Code walla Codex e abonemaa maa, walla modeel e nder Ollama. Binndi hello ngoo ina neldee tan e jeyɗo mo cuɓataa.
error_ollama_missing: Ollama huutortaaka e ordinateer ngal. Aaf ɗum iwde e ollama.com, uddit ɗum, caggal ɗuum eto kadi.
error_ollama_model_missing: Modeel ngal aawtaaka e Ollama. Yaltin ollama pull e innde modeel ngal (ko wayi no, ollama pull llama3.2), caggal ɗuum eto kadi.
options_more_models: Misal goɗɗe (gooto e nder kala diidol)
options_models_auto: Ɗi iwi ko e Claude Code, Codex e Ollama, ɗi njanngetee kadi laawol gootol ñalnde kala, so Claude Code walla Codex hesɗitinaama, e so ɓeydaari ndii hesɗitinaama.
error_file_access: Ngam timminde fiilde ɗe ordinateer ɗoo, uddit Cifooji ɓeyditte ngel e chrome://extensions, hurmin Yamir naatgol e URL fiilde.
error_pdf_unreadable: Ngal PDF waawaa udditeede. Ina waawi wonde ngal reenaama e finnde walla ngal bonii.
error_pdf_no_text: Ngal PDF alaa binndi timminteeɗi. Ina waawi wonde ngal waɗaama e nate scannaaɗe.
history_empty: Alaa timmoode tawo. Ɗe peeñay ɗoo nde mbaɗataa ɗe.
history_no_results: Alaa timmoode fotndiinde e njiylaw ngal.
error_no_transcript: Ngol widewo alaa binndi timminteeɗi. YouTube heɓata binndi ɗi si wonaa widewo ngo ina jogii subtitles walla caption automatique.
options_styles_help: Mbaydi ɓeydata timmoode ndee yamiroore, ko wayi no: Timmin ɗum wano ceŋol ɓataake tati rabbiɗɗe.
